name: Cafe Zapa
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café Zapa in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, our cozy café invites you to indulge in the finest **Tiroler** hospitality. Whether you're seeking a warm cup of coffee, a slice of freshly baked **Apfelstrudel**, or a hearty serving of **Kaiserschmarrn**, we promise an unforgettable experience.

Just a short stroll from the vibrant city center of **Innsbruck**, Café Zapa offers a perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort. Savor traditional **Tiroler** flavors paired with breathtaking mountain views—pure relaxation in every bite.

Come visit us and let the warmth of **Tirol** wrap around you! ☕️🍰
